notes: Self-contained, strictly monochrome (black/white/grey only) static site for a fictional studio named STILL. No build step, no external dependencies, relative paths; works from file:// and any subpath. All imagery is generated SVG/CSS; no stock assets. Includes responsive layout, keyboard focus, a dark/light inversion toggle, native dialog lightbox, filterable project grid, SVG download, copy-to-clipboard contact, and prefers-reduced-motion support. Content is fictional demonstration copy. Known limitations: contact is client-side only (no backend; nothing is sent), artworks are generated at runtime, theme preference uses localStorage (gracefully degrades on file://), and there is no automated test suite.
